text:
Lina: Quick sync  AWS Marketplace + NovaSystems SI are coordinating a joint launch. We need a clear lead-ownership flow for marketplace-origin leads and SI-introduced prospects.
Raj: Key ask: define when a lead is Nova-owned vs Redwood-owned.
Emma: Proposal: Nova owns if BOTH: (a) account ARR >= $100k or strategic vertical flagged, AND (b) Nova performed pre-sales intro or led a co-demo. Otherwise Redwood keeps.
Mike: How do we reliably mark "pre-sales intro" in SFDC? That field is often missed.
Alex: Use enforced tagging + meeting evidence. Pattern: add tag `partner:novasys-intro` and require a related meeting record within 30 days. Engineering can automate a sweep for missing confirmations.
Sarah-W: Marketplace signals matter too. If lead_source contains `aws-marketplace` (utm) and Nova triaged it through our intake flow, Nova gets primary routing.
Lina: So three signals: (1) partner intro tag, (2) marketplace origin + partner triage, (3) high-value accounts. Which wins?
Raj: Ownership precedence: partner-intro tag > marketplace-origin+triage > high-value. If Nova did the heavy lift, they should keep the lead.
Emma: Add a protection: if Redwood is mid-funnel (deal stage >= Proposal), do not auto-reassign without a synced SDR+AE agreement. Prevent stomping active deals.
Mike: I can make a compact decision matrix for the intake UI.
Alex: Draft automation logic:
```
if has_tag('partner:novasys-intro') and meeting_with_partner_within_days(30): owner = Nova
else if lead_source == 'aws-marketplace' and partner_triaged == true: owner = Nova
else if ARR >= 100000 and not in_deal_stage('proposal','contract'): owner = Nova
else: owner = Redwood
```
Sarah-W: Exception: if account has NAMED=true (Redwood named account list), then do NOT auto-assign to Nova unless a sales exec explicitly approves.
Lina: Good. Also define dispute flow: 1) file dispute tag + DM partner ops SME, 2) 24hr SLA for initial resolution, 3) unresolved -> weekly handoff review meeting.
Raj: partnerships-bot should surface disputes into #partnerships-disputes for visibility and audit.
partnerships-bot: automation note  will post disputed claims to #partnerships-disputes and set `dispute:open` on the CRM record. :robot_face:
Emma: Joint announcement (press) accounts are manual review only  GTM and legal signoff before any assignment.
Mike: Implementation asks for eng: add two booleans in intake API: `partner_triaged` and `partner_intro_tag` (string). Also emit webhook when marketplace utm detected.
Alex: I'll open the intake PR with SFDC mapping: tag -> custom field, `lead_source_detail` = utm_medium. Include sample webhook payload.
Lina: Timeline: intake API PR by Tue, automation rules in staging by Fri, partner ops playbook draft by EOD Fri. Who owns the playbook?
Sarah-W: I'll own the playbook draft (templates, handshake steps, dispute runbook).
Raj: I'll confirm expectations with Nova and AWS PMs about triage behavior.
Emma: Include a short email intro boilerplate so the tag step isn't missed.
Lina: Any objections? If none, we'll pilot this for the marketplace launch.
Mike: No objections from eng.
Alex: 44d
Sarah-W: All good.
Raj: No objections; will escalate partner feedback if needed.
Lina: Locked. I'll upload the playbook and ping when the PR is ready. :tada:
